name: 网页交互桌面
description: 把桌面软件做成可在线试用的网页。附带可运行的色卡画板，用来练习窗口拖动、撤销、录屏和 PNG 导出。
descriptionEn: Turn a desktop app into a hands-on web demo. The included drawing board demonstrates draggable windows, undo, recording and PNG export.

name: 软件产品全链路交付
description: 按产品类型规划开发、测试、打包和上线，包含发布清单、交接模板，以及校验产物和线上地址的 Python 工具。
descriptionEn: Plan development, testing, packaging and release for your product. Includes release checklists, handoff templates and Python tools for verifying builds and live endpoints.

name: Skill Creator
description: OpenAI 的 Codex Skill 编写指南。用随附的 Python 工具创建 Skill 目录、生成界面信息，并检查说明文件的格式。
descriptionEn: OpenAI’s guide to writing Codex skills. The included Python tools scaffold a skill, generate UI metadata and validate the skill definition.
